The USGS Minerals Yearbook 2023 lists 17 mining joint-ventures in Kazakhstan.

| Operator | Owners and share-percentages (exactly as printed) | Location (deposits) | Capacity |
|---|---|---|---|
| Akbastau JV | NAC Kazatomprom JSC, 50 %, and Uranium One Inc., 50 % | Budenovskoe deposit | 24 000 metric tons |
| APPAK LLP | NAC Kazatomprom JSC, 65 %; Sumitomo Corp., 25 %; Kansai Electric Power Co. Inc., 10 % | Mynkuduk deposit | 24 000 metric tons |
| JV Southern Mining and Chemical Co. (SMCC LLP) | Uranium One Rotterdam B.V., 70 %, and NAC Kazatomprom JSC, 30 % | Akdala Mine | 24 000 metric tons |

The largest single-stake owners are Kazatomprom (50% or more) and Uranium One Inc. (up to 50%).
All operators are JVs in which Kazatomprom holds at least 49%.

The buyers of Kazakhstan's uranium output are not in our sources.
